narration.text: Yesterday, someone escaped the floor below zero.
A courier receives the same warning.
Delivered. But she hasn't let go.
Now the radio has gone silent.
The doors open on their own.
Someone is waiting. Looking straight at her.
It isn't waiting for the parcel.
